title: Ash-Cinder Runt
text: A half-starved furnace beast noses through warm slag and snaps at anything carrying food, blood, or lamp oil.
flavor: It is more smoke than muscle, but the teeth are real.

defeatReward.text: You drove off the runt and found a safe line through the cinders.

imagePrompt: A small soot-black furnace beast with ember eyes and thin hooked teeth crouching in warm ash beside broken iron lane markers, grimdark but low-tier, readable silhouette
